proposal_title: JSON Schema Root Packaging & Fragment Entrypoint Documentation
domain_specific_rationale: From a Schema Packaging and Tooling Conformance perspective, CP-022 resolves schema validation ambiguity by documenting that domain-entities.schema.json functions as a multi-entity schema package where individual entity definitions reside under root / and are consumed via fragment entrypoints (e.g. domain-entities.schema.json#//Project, domain-entities.schema.json#//GenerationJob). Formally documenting these fragment entrypoints in CONTRACTS_OVERVIEW.md Section 2 guarantees consistent behavior across JSON Schema draft-07 validators, TypeScript interface generators (json-schema-to-typescript), and consumer-driven contract test harnesses.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-01 (Canonical Core State) and CAP-17 (Developer Experience & Contract Tooling).
residual_risk: Tooling lacking JSON pointer fragment support might attempt root object validation. Mitigated by standardizing on compliant Draft-07 validators and publishing pre-compiled TypeScript SDKs from R01.
